channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: WSJ: Robert Kraft told Ed Sheeran Macklemore’s Gaza claims were hate speech
item.description:
Robert Kraft told Ed Sheeran that Macklemore’s claims about Israel and Gaza were hate speech in a 40-minute call, according to The Wall Street Journal.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: Shabbat Shalom from Israel!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' Israel desk is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of Shabbat. Jerusalem candle lighting time is 18:01 on Friday. Our North American desk will keep you informed until the 18:42 EDT candle lighting time in New York.
The updates from Israel will resume Saturday night, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 19:16 in Jerusalem.
Shabbat Shalom!

item.title: Live: Amichai Attia laid to rest
item.description: Amichai Attia, 17, from Itamar, is being laid to rest after being fatally struck at the Village shopping complex. His aunt: 'He was very sociable, surrounded by friends, and always pleasant and welcoming.'

item.title: Suspect in missile launch incident released
item.description: Police raids in Jaljulia uncover two hidden handguns, ammunition and surveillance cameras as investigation into unusual LAW rocket attack continues.

item.title: IDF officer demands: Stop photographing soldiers
item.description: Lt. Col. (res.) Meir Indor calls for legal action against photographers who, he claims, publish images of soldiers against their wishes, citing operational security and privacy concerns.

item.title: Agreement reached: Tel Aviv Selichot to go ahead as planned
item.description: Rabbis and Tel Aviv Municipality reach court-backed agreement, clearing the way for Saturday night Selichot prayers at Tel Baruch Beach.

item.title: Selichot at Mount Herzl: Remembering fallen heroes before Yom Kippur
item.description: Bereaved families, friends and young people gather beside graves of two fallen soldiers for an emotional evening of remembrance, song and prayer.

item.title: Friedman defends Huckabee after Turmus Ayya controversy
item.description: Former US Ambassador David Friedman suggests key facts withheld from US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee before his visit, pointing to interview with Amishav Melet.

item.title: Israeli arrested over suspected contact with Lebanese agent
item.description: Majd al-Krum resident knowingly maintained contact with foreign agent from Lebanon, was asked to carry out security-related missions, investigation reveals.

item.title: Teshuvah begins with a verb
item.description: Words matter enormously. Yom Kippur is filled with them. We confess, pray, plead and ask to be forgiven. But our words have to result in something.

item.title: Two Torah scrolls dedicated in memory of fallen police officers
item.description: Moving ceremony honors five members of the Southern District’s Sahar Unit, including three officers who fell in the battles of October 7.

item.title: Teshuva and Shalom
item.description: Teshuva comes to us through manifestations that can be divided into four eternal, absolute values which appear in a cognizant step-by-step fashion. These values are honor, love, knowledge, and life.

item.title: Trump must decide -- deal or regime change
item.description: One cannot simultaneously call upon the Iranian people to rise up and, at the most critical moment-in the midst of their uprising-pursue a deal or an “agreement" with the very government they are risking their lives to overthrow. iOpinion.

item.title: IDF goes on heightened alert for Yom Kippur
item.description: Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir orders reinforcements across all fronts, with armed aircraft, missile ships and additional forces placed on standby.

item.title: Celebrate the seasons
item.description: The calendar itself is a dialogue between Heaven and Israel. G-d gave us His appointed times, and in return we gave Him ours.

item.title: Protesters tear down PLO flag in Amsterdam
item.description: Crowd erupts in cheers as pro-Israel demonstrators pull massive PLO flag from building overlooking Amsterdam’s Dam Square.

item.title: Arab journalist arrested over suspected ties to Iran
item.description: Female Arab journalist under investigation for suspected contact with Iran, incitement and support for terrorism, police say.

item.title: October 7 survivor to UN chief: Hamas is planning the next massacre
item.description: Tzav 9's Yael Savarigo hits back at UN Secretary-General António Guterres: 'We demand UN stop supporting terrorist organizations, focus on disarming Hamas.'

item.title: The truth of Yom Kippur, the lies of the Foreign Ministers
item.description: The dream of a return to Zion and the Holy Temple is the engine that created the momentum harnessed by the modern Zionism of Herzl’s time and used to create the modern State of Israel.

item.description: It’s never all or nothing.

item.title: The malignancy of the left
item.description: An astonishing ovation revealed the importance of anti-Zionist Israelis to the global campaign to destroy the Jewish state. Opinion.

item.description: Tamra resident repeatedly contacted Hamas, later established ties with Iranian intelligence before being arrested, Shin Bet, Israel Police reveal.

item.title: Yeshiva student killed in Hadera ramming
item.description: Amichai Attia, a 12th-grade student from Samaria, named as teen victim killed in ramming by Arab driver; police say incident was criminal, not terrorism.

item.title: Parshat Ha’azinu: The makings of a brachah
item.description: Parshat Ha’azinu teaches why the words of our prophets and sages carry the force of a Divine command - and why we recite blessings on rabbinic mitzvot.

item.title: New poll: Likud drops to 18 seats, Winter crosses threshold
item.description: Yashar! leads with 23 seats as Likud continues to slide, while Amcha Yisrael returns to the Knesset; right-wing bloc holds at 50 Knesset seats.
